files.hooks/data/snapshot.ts:
/**
 * One snapshot of everything the console draws from disk: the files read (./files), parsed (./parse, ./facts), plus the
 * ruflo marketplace clone's manifest. A fact a file does not hold is null and its read's reason says why; the views
 * draw that as n/a, missing or too large, never as zero.
 */
import { readAnatole, type AnatoleFacts } from './anatole'
import { readRecall, type RecallFacts } from './recall'
import {
  enabledOf,
  parseActivity,
  parseDaemon,
  parseHarnessPolicy,
  parseHelpers,
  parseInstalled,
  parseMarketplaceManifest,
  parseMarketplaces,
  parseNeural,
  parseOutcomes,
  parseRouter,
  parseSona,
  type Daemon,
  type Installed,
  type Marketplace,
  type NeuralStats,
  type Outcomes,
  type RouterState,
} from './facts'
import { parseMissions, type MissionObservation } from './missions'
import { readBounded, readDisk, textOf, type ProjectKey, type Read, type ReadCache, type ReaderFs } from './files'
import { parseAgentdbMod, type AgentdbMod } from './agentdb-mod'
import { readMods, type ModsFacts } from './mods'
import {
  parseAgents,
  parseClaims,
  parseHive,
  parseHiveAgents,
  parseSwarmPointer,
  parseSwarmStore,
  parseTasks,
  type AgentRecord,
  type ClaimRecord,
  type HiveAgentRecord,
  type HiveInfo,
  type SwarmInfo,
  type TaskRecord,
} from './parse'

/** The marketplace this repository publishes, and the plugins a current clone of it must list. */
export const RUFLO_MARKET = 'ruflo'
export const EXPECTED_IN_MARKET = ['ruflo-core', 'ruflo-mods', 'ruflo-swarm'] as const

export type PluginsFacts = {
  installed: Installed[] | null
  enabled: Set<string>
  /** Whether the merged settings held an `enabledPlugins` record at all: without one, "not enabled" is not known (ADR-485). */
  enabledKnown?: boolean
  markets: Marketplace[] | null
  /** The ruflo clone's plugin names, or null when the clone or its manifest is not readable. */
  rufloOffered: string[] | null
  /** Expected plugins the clone does not list: non-empty means the clone is stale. */
  missingFromClone: string[]
}

export type Snapshot = {
  reads: Record<ProjectKey, ReadStatus>
  swarm: SwarmInfo | null
  agents: AgentRecord[]
  tasks: TaskRecord[]
  claims: ClaimRecord[]
  hive: HiveInfo | null
  /** Workers `hive-mind spawn` wrote to .claude-flow/agents.json, apart from the agent store. */
  hiveAgents: HiveAgentRecord[]
  activity: ReturnType<typeof parseActivity>
  daemon: Daemon | null
  neural: NeuralStats | null
  router: RouterState | null
  outcomes: Outcomes | null
  sona: { patterns: number } | null
  harnessPolicy: ReturnType<typeof parseHarnessPolicy>
  helpers: ReturnType<typeof parseHelpers>
  helpersVersion: string | null
  isRufloProject: boolean
  federationNodes: string[] | null
  hasNostrKey: boolean | null
  plugins: PluginsFacts
  missions: MissionObservation | null
  /** The ruflo-agentdb mod's own status file (ADR-445); null while the mod has not written one. */
  agentdbMod: AgentdbMod | null
  /** Project Anatole's reported files (ADR-453): unauthenticated, bounded, shape-checked. */
  anatole?: AnatoleFacts
  /** What the intelligence hook recalls from and what the neural verbs act on (ADR-456): bounded reads, never a prompt the hook did not keep. */
  recall?: RecallFacts
  /** Every `.claude-flow/<short>-mod/status.json` the per-plugin mods wrote (ADR-446), bounded and shape-checked. */
  mods: ModsFacts
  changed: number
  readAtMs: number
}

export type ReadStatus = 'ok' | 'missing' | 'too-large' | 'refused' | 'not-regular'

const statusOf = (read: Read): ReadStatus => (read.text !== null ? 'ok' : read.reason)

/** Reads and parses everything; never rejects. `settings` is the merged settings, for `enabledPlugins`. */
export async function readSnapshot(fs: ReaderFs, cache: ReadCache, cwd: string, home: string | null, settings: unknown, nowMs: number, configDir?: string | null, federationNetwork = false): Promise<Snapshot> {
  const disk = await readDisk(fs, cache, cwd, home, configDir === undefined ? (home === null ? null : `${home}/.claude`) : configDir, federationNetwork)
  const text = (key: ProjectKey) => textOf(disk.project[key])
  const stored = parseSwarmStore(text('swarm'))
  const pointer = parseSwarmPointer(text('pointer'))
  const swarm: SwarmInfo | null =
    stored ?? (pointer !== null ? { id: pointer.id, topology: pointer.topology ?? 'unknown', status: pointer.status ?? 'unknown', agentIds: [], ...(pointer.strategy !== undefined && { strategy: pointer.strategy }) } : null)
  const markets = parseMarketplaces(textOf(disk.home.marketplaces))
  const location = markets?.find(market => market.name === RUFLO_MARKET)?.location
  const offered = location === undefined ? null : parseMarketplaceManifest(textOf(await readBounded(fs, cache, `${location}/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`)))
  const reads = Object.fromEntries((Object.keys(disk.project) as ProjectKey[]).map(key => [key, statusOf(disk.project[key])])) as Snapshot['reads']

  return {
    reads,
    swarm,
    agents: parseAgents(text('agents')),
    tasks: parseTasks(text('tasks')),
    claims: parseClaims(text('claims')),
    hive: parseHive(text('hive')),
    hiveAgents: parseHiveAgents(text('hiveAgents')),
    activity: parseActivity(text('activity')),
    daemon: parseDaemon(text('daemon')),
    neural: parseNeural(text('neural')),
    router: parseRouter(text('router')),
    outcomes: parseOutcomes(text('outcomes')),
    sona: parseSona(text('sona')),
    harnessPolicy: parseHarnessPolicy(text('harnessPolicy')),
    helpers: parseHelpers(text('helpersManifest')),
    helpersVersion: text('helpersVersion')?.trim().slice(0, 20) ?? null,
    isRufloProject: text('config') !== null || swarm !== null || text('claims') !== null || text('daemon') !== null,
    federationNodes: disk.federationNodes,
    hasNostrKey: disk.hasNostrKey,
    plugins: {
      installed: parseInstalled(textOf(disk.home.installed)),
      enabled: enabledOf(settings),
      enabledKnown: typeof (settings as { enabledPlugins?: unknown } | null)?.enabledPlugins === 'object' && (settings as { enabledPlugins?: unknown }).enabledPlugins !== null,
      markets,
      rufloOffered: offered,
      missingFromClone: offered === null ? [] : EXPECTED_IN_MARKET.filter(name => !offered.includes(name)),
    },
    missions: parseMissions(text('missions')),
    agentdbMod: parseAgentdbMod(text('agentdbMod')),
    mods: await readMods(fs, cache, cwd),
    anatole: await readAnatole(fs, cache, cwd),
    recall: await readRecall(fs, cache, cwd),
    changed: disk.changed,
    readAtMs: nowMs,
  }
}
files.hooks/version.ts:
/**
 * The console's version, shown on the header so a person can tell which build is running. Kept equal to the plugin's manifest
 * (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`); tests/version.spec.ts fails if the two drift.
 */
export const CONSOLE_VERSION = '0.42.0'

{
  "name": "ruflo-console",
  "description": "ruflo's cockpit inside Claude Code and the one /ruflo command for every ruflo mod (function hooks, early access). Views: overview with health alerts, swarm topology graph, claims flow with TTL rings, federation map, plugin health matrix, learning curve and pipeline, MetaHarness radar and audit trend, memory, cost gauge, agent timeline, approvals queue, event stream, a main menu, an x.ruv.io federation board, an AI terminal (codex, claude or both in remembered sessions, streamed), Skills (npx skills), a Hive-Mind view, a MetaHarness lab, agent drill-down; a command palette for confirm-gated actions through the ruflo CLI; a band above the prompt. Reads ruflo's files and the CLI's local JSON; anything not measured reads n/a. The one network call it makes by itself is a daily read of the published plugin.json at github.com/ruvnet/ruflo to offer an update (Settings → Updates: ask, auto, or off); it installs only through Claude Code's own claude plugin update, and never a new major version without asking.",
  "version": "0.42.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "approvals",
    "claims",
    "console",
    "dashboard",
    "federation",
    "function-hooks",
    "metaharness",
    "mods",
    "palette",
    "pane",
    "ruflo",
    "swarm",
    "timeline"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "convoTargets": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conversation targets",
      "description": "endpoint:<name>=<base-url>|<KEY_ENV>|<model>; bbs:<room>; x:<channel>. Names of environment variables, never keys. Default empty: only OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY) is offered.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "cli": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ruflo CLI",
      "description": "How the console reaches ruflo. npx-offline (default) uses the locally cached @claude-flow/cli and never touches the network; npx may download it; ruflo and claude-flow use a global install.",
      "default": "npx-offline",
      "options": [
        "npx-offline",
        "npx",
        "ruflo",
        "claude-flow"
      ]
    },
    "refreshSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Disk refresh (seconds)",
      "description": "How often ruflo's files are re-read (2 to 60). Unchanged files are not read again. CLI probes keep their own slower cadence and run only for the view in front.",
      "default": 3
    },
    "fps": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Animation frames per second",
      "description": "Frame cap while the pane is shown and holds the keys (0 to 12; 0 turns motion off). Hidden, unfocused or closed, nothing animates.",
      "default": 8
    },
    "bar": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band above the prompt",
      "description": "auto shows the one-line ruflo band in a ruflo project; on shows it everywhere; off hides it (the console then adds a 'console' segment to ruflo-mods' status line instead).",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "panel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cockpit pane",
      "description": "auto opens the cockpit at session start where it docks beside the transcript (a terminal 144 columns or wider), never taking the keys; elsewhere the band says /ruflo to open. command opens it only with /ruflo. off never opens it unasked.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "command",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "federationNetwork": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Ask the federation relay",
      "description": "Lets the federation and x.ruv.io views ask the public relay (wss://relay.ruv.io) for the roster and the x.ruv.io gateway for its registry. Off by default: without it the console makes no network request.",
      "default": false
    },
    "look": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Look",
      "description": "bbs is the neon BBS look: an ASCII-art banner, ▓▒░ section headers and a cyberpunk palette. plain uses your terminal theme colours and plain rules (better on light backgrounds).",
      "default": "bbs",
      "options": [
        "bbs",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "boot": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Boot screen",
      "description": "With the bbs look, play a dial-up boot screen (modem connect, the RUFLO logo drawing in, every area of the console coming online in a log, a loading bar for the first ruflo reads) when the cockpit opens. At least 5.4 s, at most 8 s.",
      "default": true
    },
    "eventsPersist": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Keep Events history",
      "description": "Keep the Events and Timeline history on disk in this project (.claude-flow/console/: events.jsonl, lanes.jsonl, events-prefs.json, exports/) so a restart does not empty the pages. Text is masked before it is written (credentials, home-directory user names, control characters); nothing leaves the machine and no model reads it. Off writes nothing; the pages still work for the session.",
      "default": true
    },
    "sessionWorkspace": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Session workspace",
      "description": "The Room lists the sessions on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo missions and workers), started in Ruflo or not, with a Needs you queue (approvals, questions, failures, finished work) and a preview of the one you pick.       "default": true
    },
    "sessionPreview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Session preview",
      "description": "Show the latest response, current tool, edited files and test result of the selected session.       "default": true
    },
    "wfBudgetRunUsd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Workflow budget per run (USD)",
      "description": "The Workflows page flags a run whose measured cost passes this many dollars (0.01 to 10000; 0 turns the guard off). It only warns: the console cannot stop a running workflow.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "wfBudgetDayUsd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Workflow budget per day (USD)",
      "description": "The Workflows page flags the day's measured workflow cost past this many dollars (0.01 to 10000; 0 turns the guard off). It only warns.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "wfAlertRules": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workflow alert rules",
      "description": "Space-separated rules for the Workflows page: stuck>20m (no progress for 20 minutes), tokens>2M (agent context size), dirty (a worktree has uncommitted changes). Empty turns them all off.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
